metaDescription: Kevin argues the recent bank, airline and Microsoft outages may be AI-enabled cyber attacks, tied to open-source AI regulation, CBDCs and Whitney Webb.
summary: This live stream covers Kevin's theory about the recent outages hitting U.S. banks, airlines, the FAA, Microsoft and Apple. Kevin argues they may be cyber attacks run by people using AI agents, not rogue AI. He predicts the blame will fall on open-source and Chinese AI models, leading to regulation that benefits frontier labs such as OpenAI and Anthropic. He cites an FBI Dallas advisory about the Rex penetration-testing framework and a Whitney Webb clip on cyber attacks and CBDCs. Kevin also discusses his friend Rory's advice to pull money from banks, BlackRock's holdings, the Tim Hortons app data report, and The Nerd Reich book club.
